notes.title: Spring Cleaning Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33512427/e2df6ebd8907ac446fbdb17407e592a8d9263fa7.gif[/img]

[h1][b]COMBOS[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 3 brand new Combo animations
[*] 2 out of the 3 Combos feature a new hero from the Epicton Kingdom, [u][i][b]Knight Captain Boros![/b][/i][/u]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33512427/b4905099b5ac2e9438c6345662210c92b409204a.gif[/img]

[h1][b]HARD MODE[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new Mini-mini Pig Boss encounter upon starting Hard Mode. Challenge accepted!
[/list]

[h1][b]GAME CONTROL[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] There's now a short transition time when moving Lunaya both backwards and forwards (instead of instantly)
[*] Players are no longer able to spam Lunaya's movement (back and fro) just by holding down a single key (keyboard) or button (controller). 1 key pressed equates to 1 movement
[/list]

[h1][b]GAME BALANCE[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced the Jewels needed to get Alano and help you in the adventure from 100 to 40 (60% discount)
[*] Increased Lunaya's combo attack damage by 5% (Level 8 to 15) and 10% (Level 16) respectively during both Wizard Pig and Elite Pig Boss Fights
[*] Reduced Knight Pig Boss health by 10% from 20 to 18
[*] Reduced Elite Pig Boss health by 5% from 100 to 95
[*] Added 4 more tiers of Health Packs and 3 more tiers of "The Thunderbolt" skill to purchase
[*] More detailed hint(s) involving each Bosses are now given at the start of every fights (except Mini-mini Pig Boss)
[*] Reduced the requirement needed to encounter Knight Pig Boss from 2000 Score to 1500
[/list]

[h1][b]BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Faster loading time and smoother playing experience
[*] Linux version is now available!
[*] The timing to get a result out of the Jackpot Mini-game have been greatly reduced, which increase real game time
[*] Fixed a bug that forced the game to go into Full Screen when switching between different layouts
[*] Slowed down the timing to automatically switch cutscenes at the start of the game
[*] Players are now able to start the game by pressing the "Spacebar" key on the keyboard
[*] Text Instructions during Mini-Games and Boss Fights are now clearly displayed (bigger size and slightly longer duration) than before
[*] Minor UI Fixes
[*] 2 out of the 4 Combos that are summonable during Elite Pig Boss's fight are now replaced with the new Combo animations
[*] Fixed "Calculating" spelling error
[*] Muting sound will now work properly across all layouts
[*] Game will now start in Windowed mode. Press the "F" key to go Full Screen (optional)
[*] Sprites should no longer lingers on the screen unnecessary
[*] Shop layout changed a little to represent the items better
[*] Title screen illustration and game icon changed
[*] Added 2 new achievements for defeating Mini-mini Pig Boss and Knight Captain Boros Combo
[*] Miscellaneous bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Prior to Chapter 1.5
notes.notes:
[url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/challenge/meatpossible/chapter-11/viewer?title_no=71441&episode_no=1][h1]PREQUEL - CHAPTER 1-1 & 1-2[/h1][/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33512427/27b234523f00a8a588b3a62cbdcb39da93ce11db.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33512427/55ba0c9f07dd74e23ea572a2d42feb4b8f53f22a.jpg[/img]

   “Huff..”
   Both the princess eyeballs are enlarged and bulging up and down panicky. Her face cheek trembles in fear, while a few drops of sweats rolled down.
   “Puff...”
   She is still having difficulty in catching her breath, even with her mouth wide opened. She attempts to inhale deep breath in a slow steady interval in order to calm herself down.
   The smell of the grass, trees, and soil helped to heightened all her senses.
   Starting to look left and right, streaks of strong light were seen bursting across right in front of her.
   Despite that, only the vision of a big boulder caught her sight.
   The princess line of sight begins to move in and became slightly clearer by every seconds, which process the estimated distance between her position and the rock.
   The boulder is surely within reach. It's just right beyond a dozen of trees.
   She suddenly feel that the surrounding is spinning around her head. She have to keep moving...
   She lifted her right leg and took baby steps.
   “Ooooiiiinnnnkkkk!”
   “Aiiiiiiieeeeee?!!!”
   “Gasps”
   The princess started to take bigger steps and eventually she found herself running. Both her legs brush against the green grass as she past by.
   She picked up her courage, turned her head a bit and taken a look behind.
   It's a pig!
   That's no ordinary pig though. The creature looks mutated. The pig lookalike is floating above ground with no visible wings.
   Perhaps the two leaves each on both it's front legs is enabling the creature to do that...
   Perhaps the two stripes each on both it's back leg is propelling the pig forward...
   Perhaps the single stripe of bacon right on top of the pig nose is...
   Too many perhaps, yet the princess instinctively picked up her pace.
   She ran by the first tree towards the destination.
   “Ring! Ring!”
   The pig is approaching closer as the bell that was on the creature back is shaking furiously.
   The princess proceed swiftly and dash over to the boulder.
   She tried to hide behind the rock, away from the sight of the pig.
   She cover her mouth to stop any noise that could possibly comes from her. Her face froze and wish for the best result.
   With a blink of eye, the pig appear right in front of her, seated on another small rock.
   “Found you!”
